description.value: Kamome is a Japanese fusion restaurant in Tsawwassen with over 100 seats and a spacious layout well-suited to group dining. Its extensive menu spans traditional sushi and creative pan-Asian fusion dishes, and the kitchen emphasises eco-friendly non-plastic packaging for takeout orders. It is the sister restaurant of South Surrey's Kami Japanese and affiliated with Woo Korean BBQ, placing it within an established local restaurant group.

address.value: #2222 - 4949 Canoe Pass Way, Tsawwassen, BC V4M 0B2
